title: Man charged after allegedly trying to disarm officer during violent street arrest
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Crime “While officers continued their attempts to arrest the suspect, the confrontation spilled out into the street, increasing the dangerousness of the altercation due to the heavy rain and traffic.
" A man allegedly assaulted and attempted to disarm a Boston police officer while being taken into custody on two outstanding warrants in the South End.

Felix Omar David Marrero, 34, was arrested Sunday on charges of assault and battery attempt to disarm a police officer, two counts of assault and battery on a police officer, resisting arrest, disorderly conduct, disturbing the peace, and receiving stolen property.

title: BJ’s marks 42 years with $25 million in gift cards for workers
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Business The Marlborough-based retailer is giving more than 30,000 hourly employees gift cards worth $250 to $2,000 based on their tenure.
BJ's Wholesale Club CEO Bob Eddy at the Northborough location.
